method: Shipped single-thread SIMD WASM, verified Renju weights; fixed legal positions, clear hash per case. Adaptive uses one total wall deadline after warmup, candidate discovery, opponent replies and unrestricted final root; opening comparisons share their deadline. Shortcuts use shared exact legality rules. This checks finite mechanisms, legality and timing, not human win-rate or guaranteed superiority over fixed 6-second search.
